attr.title: MDPP
attr.desc: MilkDrop Portable Player — plays MP3/FLAC/Ogg with real-time MilkDrop visualizations. Drop your music files into /roms/ports/mdpp/ and enjoy a psychedelic audio experience on your handheld.
attr.inst: Copy song.mp3 (or any MP3/FLAC/Ogg) to /roms/ports/mdpp/. Presets are in /roms/ports/mdpp/presets/.
